_comment: REFERENCE ONLY — do NOT merge into manifest.json until the calling bot is registered in Azure. These are the properties Tier 2 adds: a calling bot, the AAD app link, and meeting RSC read permissions. Replace {{BOT_ID}} with the bot's Azure AD app id. See docs/TIER2.md.
_note_application_permissions: The media capabilities (joining a call, accessing media) are AAD *application* permissions granted via admin consent in Azure, NOT via this manifest: Calls.JoinGroupCall.All and Calls.AccessMedia.All. See docs/TIER2.md → 'Azure setup'.
